'''Ko Itub''' was a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] who, along with her [[Parent/Legends|sister]] [[Rina Itub]], accompanied [[Yee Moh]] in the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Ko was to the right of Moh during [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell's]] [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|brief stay at the nightclub]].<ref name="ATC" />
